posts.title: Album of the day #9 - Marginalia VI
posts.description: Since 2016, Japanese artist and musician Masakatsu Takagi has been recording improvisational piano sessions accompanied by lush soundscapes from the world outside.

posts.title: Album of the day #8 - The Servile
posts.description: The Servile sounds like a fusion of many of the rock subgenres I grew up loving as a teenager in the mid-to-late 2010s, but it interprets them with a fresh perspective to produce something that can stand on its own.

posts.title: Album of the day #7 - I Heard That Noise
posts.description: The best way I can describe this album is that it sounds like violently traversing a multiverse to find pockets of comforting music and song.
